purpose: Make stable, repeatable, auditable data the primary decision layer. Hard-to-get data can modify confidence or advance timing, but cannot override the permission gate.

market_regime_and_losing_money_effect.description: Market breadth, limit-up/down structure, sentiment, and losing-money effect.

sector_resonance_and_role.description: Leader, core anchor, catch-up, follower, and sector breadth comparison.

opening_absorption_0935.description: Price versus open, VWAP, first-five-minute absorption, and sector synchronization.

risk_reward_liquidity.description: Structural stop, stop distance, liquidity, expected R, and account risk budget.

kline_relative_strength.description: Daily/minute structure, moving averages, volume, and relative strength.

source_backed_catalyst.description: Structured announcement, news, IR, or industry-chain evidence with source and timestamp.

a2_auction_early_permission.rule: Only advances eligible action from 09:35 confirmation to 09:28 early permission.

fund_flow_proxy.rule: Vendor-classified proxy only; never true institutional intent.

chips_holder_margin_structure.rule: Slow structure modifier; not an intraday hard trigger.

non_negotiable_gates: No A0: no sizing or buy/add/reduce/sell advice.
No A1: no high-confidence stock plan.
No B1: market-regime confidence cannot exceed medium.
No A2: no 09:28 chase-strength and no auction-outperformance claim.
Any buy/add plan still needs market permission, structural stop, target R, invalidation, and do-not-trade condition.
